header.note: US release dates and Fed decisions, with the source and fetch date of each. The kinds, names, importance, scope and release times live in MarketEventSeed.cs. A date is a release only: correction and seasonal-revision days are dropped. Before the key series' first vintage every date is kept; otherwise CPIAUCSL, PAYEMS and PPIFIS must start a vintage that day whose newest period is newer than the previous kept date's, and GDPC1 need only start one that day (second and third estimates are real). PPI has no offline vintages: the earlier of two PPI dates in the same February within 7 days is dropped, inferred from CPI's pattern, not checked against PPI data. Figures are the values visible on the release day itself (never a later vintage). Figure row columns, aligned by index with each date array: cpi [CPI month change %, previous, core CPI month change %, previous]; nfp [payrolls change thousands, previous, unemployment %, previous]; gdp [growth % annualized, estimate number, previous, period]. Percentages are 1 decimal, payrolls whole thousands; ppi_figures is all null. A date after the fetch day is a scheduled release, kept with no figures.
